title: A contact book
summary: Commands that add, find and delete records kept in a growing array of structs.
hints: `struct contact { char name[32]; char phone[32]; };` in an array that grows with `realloc`. Read the command word with `scanf("%31s", cmd)` and then, depending on it, its arguments.
To delete entry `i` shift the following ones one position down with `memmove` (or a loop) and decrease the count: the order of the rest must not change.
